result.instructions: Tools for Telegram, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the messages that people sent to my bot since yesterday."; "How many members does my channel have, and who are the administrators?"; "Send the text 'Deploy finished' to my team group.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Telegram data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run telegram_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run telegram_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run telegram_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. telegram_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: telegram_get_me
tools.title: Get the bot
tools.description: Return the bot's own profile (id, name, username, group-join and inline settings). Use it to confirm the token works. Bot API: getMe.

tools.name: telegram_get_chat
tools.title: Get a chat
tools.description: Get the details of a chat the bot belongs to: type, title, username, description, pinned message, permissions. Bot API: getChat.

chat_id.description: Chat id (number, negative for groups) or @channelusername. The bot must be a member of the chat.

tools.name: telegram_get_chat_member_count
tools.title: Count chat members
tools.description: Get the number of members in a chat. Bot API: getChatMemberCount.

chat_id.description: Chat id (number, negative for groups) or @channelusername. The bot must be a member of the chat.

tools.name: telegram_get_chat_member
tools.title: Get a chat member
tools.description: Get one member of a chat: status (creator, administrator, member, restricted, left, kicked) and rights. Bot API: getChatMember.

chat_id.description: Chat id (number, negative for groups) or @channelusername. The bot must be a member of the chat.

tools.name: telegram_get_chat_administrators
tools.title: List chat administrators
tools.description: List the administrators of a group or channel (not other bots' hidden admins). Bot API: getChatAdministrators.

chat_id.description: Chat id (number, negative for groups) or @channelusername. The bot must be a member of the chat.

tools.name: telegram_get_updates
tools.title: Get pending updates
tools.description: Read the messages and events that users sent to the bot and that wait in Telegram's queue (short poll, no wait). Without offset the same updates return again. A positive offset above an update_id, or a negative offset, deletes older updates in Telegram (this cannot be undone). allowed_updates changes the bot's saved update filter. Fails with HTTP 409 if the bot has a webhook. Bot API: getUpdates.

offset.description: First update_id to return. A value above an update_id confirms and deletes that update and all older ones.

allowed_updates.description: Update types to receive, for example ["message","callback_query"].

tools.name: telegram_send_message
tools.title: Send a message
tools.description: WRITE: send a text message from the bot to a chat. The message is visible to real people and cannot be unsent except with telegram_delete_message. Bot API: sendMessage.

chat_id.description: Chat id (number, negative for groups) or @channelusername. The bot must be a member of the chat.

parse_mode.description: Formatting mode. Omit for plain text.

reply_to_message_id.description: Reply to this message id in the same chat.

tools.name: telegram_edit_message_text
tools.title: Edit a message
tools.description: WRITE: change the text of a message that the bot sent. This replaces the old text. Bot API: editMessageText.

chat_id.description: Chat id (number, negative for groups) or @channelusername. The bot must be a member of the chat.

parse_mode.description: Formatting mode. Omit for plain text.

tools.name: telegram_delete_message
tools.title: Delete a message
tools.description: WRITE: delete a message. This cannot be undone. A bot can delete its own messages and incoming private-chat messages. In groups it needs the delete-messages admin right for other messages. Telegram allows deletion only for messages up to 48 hours old in most cases. Bot API: deleteMessage.

chat_id.description: Chat id (number, negative for groups) or @channelusername. The bot must be a member of the chat.
